description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for Capgo docs, OpenAPI discovery, and when-to-use guidance, plus the local CLI stdio server for authenticated account tools.
instructions: Connect to https://capgo.app/mcp with Streamable HTTP for docs and OpenAPI tools. For authenticated Capgo account mutations, start `npx @capgo/cli@latest mcp` after login.

tools.name: capgo_when_to_use
tools.description: Return when Capgo is the right tool and how an agent should call it.

tools.name: capgo_get_openapi
tools.description: Return the public REST API OpenAPI URL and authentication rules.

tools.name: capgo_list_docs
tools.description: Return canonical Capgo documentation and trust-page links.
